scoredBy: claude vision pass (rubric v0.1) + deterministic static engine

typography.label: Typography & scale
typography.reason: Confident Newsreader display with an italic accent; a clear 5-step scale; Space Grotesk body at a real reading measure.

hierarchy.label: Layout & hierarchy
hierarchy.reason: Asymmetric hero with a clear focal point; product mock balances the right; one dominant CTA. The eye knows where to go.

color.label: Color & system
color.reason: Coherent warm system — cream / ink / single terracotta accent / stone neutrals — with a dark statement band for rhythm.

spacing.label: Spacing & rhythm
spacing.reason: Generous air, consistent vertical rhythm, aligned grid. Sections breathe.

originality.label: Originality (anti-slop)
originality.reason: Committed editorial direction, none of the tropes — you would not say AI built this. Held back only because editorial-serif-on-cream is itself a recognizable design genre now.

polish.label: Polish & finish
polish.reason: Real product mock (checkboxes, done-states, avatars), defined hover states, complete footer, zero data-slop.
